rules.description: A valid driving licence must exist to cancel
rules.reason_if_failed: No driving licence found to cancel. If you believe this is an error, contact DVLA.

rules.description: Reporter must be the licence holder, executor, or next of kin
rules.reason_if_failed: Only the licence holder, executor, or next of kin can cancel a driving licence

rules.description: A valid reason for cancellation must be provided
rules.reason_if_failed: The reason provided is not valid for licence cancellation

rules.description: Death cancellations require death certificate or Tell Us Once reference
rules.reason_if_failed: Death certificate number or Tell Us Once reference required for death notifications

edge_cases.description: Licence already cancelled via Tell Us Once service
edge_cases.action: Inform reporter that cancellation has already been processed. No further action needed.

edge_cases.description: Licence holder has an active driving ban
edge_cases.action: Route to specialist team. Court ban takes precedence over voluntary cancellation.
Handoff to medical review team. Cannot process voluntary cancellation during medical review.
Accept declaration that licence is unavailable. Proceed with cancellation but flag for monitoring.
